verdict.rationale: Gumloop agents connect to your data/tools (Connectors, Sheets, Salesforce, Gmail) and produce AI-generated artifacts like reports, spreadsheets, and dashboards directly from that data, and the agent Performance view surfaces analysis of agent behavior/quality — all of which function as AI-generated insights derived from user data. However, there's no dedicated 'insights/suggestions' feature (e.g., proactive recommendations engine) distinct from general agent task output, and no independent corroboration of this specific use case. Missing for 10: a purpose-built insights/suggestions surface, independent/hands-on validation, and explicit proactive-suggestion behavior beyond task execution.
